[Chaos Zone] Crest of Wrath/Garden of Decay\n Consumed by Tiamat’s gaze, Players cannot recognise identities. Names fade into the haze, In the chaos of indiscernible entities.

[Conflict Zone] Crest of Wrath/Garden of Decay/Fissure Splitter/Shrine of Petrification/Gravity Ruins\n A zone of conflict over the conquest of Arcanium. Daevas are hostile if they belong to different legions, Where free combat is possible regardless of faction. Identities are easily recognisable in these regions.

[Neutral Zone] Forlorn Copse\n Through the mediation of the Black Cloud Merchants, Combat is restricted in this zone. Gathering and quests see safe resurgence, In the only place in Teva where peace is at home.
